title: The Story Behind Chime's Meteoric Rise - Melissa Alvarado (Chime) + Lauren Koldony (Acrew Capital)
description:
At a valuation of over $14.5 billion, Chime has quickly become America’s most valuable consumer software fintech, with millions of members. Behind the scenes is CMO Melissa Alvarado, who will share her approach and advice on building a wildly successful customer acquisition and monetization strategy. She is joined by Acrew Capital Founding Partner, Lauren Kolodny.
